statBlock.name: Vegepygmy
statBlock.description: A small fungus person that hunts in damp forests and caves. It communicates by hissing, gesturing, and tapping its body, and often lives among myconids and other fungi.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The fungus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks where abundant plant growth provides concealment.
Regeneration. The fungus regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and this trait fails to restore any.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Russet Mold:
Identification. This reddish-brown mold grows in darkness and damp warmth. On metal, a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check distinguishes it from rust.
Exposure. A creature that comes within 5 ft. must make a DC 13 Constitution save against the released spores. On a failure, it is poisoned and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as mold sprouts on it. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect. Magic that neutralizes poison or cures disease also destroys the infestation.
New growth. A creature dies if this damage reduces it to 0 HP. If the victim is a beast, giant, or humanoid, its corpse produces newborn Vegepygmies after 24 hours. A Small corpse produces one, Medium two, Large four, Huge eight, and Gargantuan sixteen. Moldies born from beasts take the form of Thornies.
Clearing it. Each point of acid, necrotic, or radiant damage clears 1 square foot. A pound of salt, a gallon of alcohol, or magic that cures disease clears a 10-foot square. Sunlight destroys exposed patches. Weapons and most other damage have no effect.

statBlock.name: Vegepygmy Chief
statBlock.description: Other Vegepygmies defer to these hardy elders. Each grows clusters of spores that can poison nearby creatures and seed new mold folk.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The fungus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks where abundant plant growth provides concealment.
Regeneration. The fungus regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and this trait fails to restore any.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks or two melee Spear attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with a two-handed melee attack.
Spores (1/day). A spore cloud spreads in a 15-foot radius around the chief and reaches around corners. Each non-plant creature in the area makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is poisoned and takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect.
sections.Spore-borne offspring: An eligible creature that dies while infected by the chief’s spores produces new Vegepygmies as described under Russet Mold in the Vegepygmy profile.

statBlock.name: War Priest
statBlock.description: A devotee of a war deity who plans battles, leads soldiers, counters hostile spellcasters, and tends to the wounded.

sections.Spellcasting:
A 9th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Light, Mending, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Divine Favor, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Magic Weapon, Prayer of Healing, Silence, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (3 slots). Beacon of Hope, Crusader's Mantle, Dispel Magic, Revivify, Spirit Guardians, Water Walk.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith, Stoneskin.
5th level (1 slot). Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds, Hold Monster.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Guided Strike (recharges after a short or long rest). After the priest or another creature within 30 ft. rolls an attack, the priest can grant +10 to the roll before the hit or miss is determined.

statBlock.name: Warlock of the Archfey
statBlock.description: A pact with a lord of the Feywild gives this warlock magic. It may keep company with boggles, quicklings, redcaps, satyrs, or sprites.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image, Speak with Animals.
1/day. Conjure Fey.
sections.Spellcasting:
An 11th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Dancing Lights, Eldritch Blast, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots). Blink, Charm Person, Dimension Door, Dominate Beast, Faerie Fire, Fear, Hold Monster, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Seeming, Sleep.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Misty Escape (recharges after a short or long rest). When the warlock takes damage, it becomes invisible and teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It stays invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

statBlock.name: Warlock of the Fiend
statBlock.description: An archfiend of the Lower Planes grants this warlock power. Imps or quasits sometimes serve as companions. The warlock may aid fiendish cults or hunt them down.

sections.Languages: Any two languages (usually Abyssal or Infernal).
sections.Damage resistances: Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, unless the attack uses a silvered weapon.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Alter Self, False Life, Levitate (self only), Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Finger of Death, Plane Shift.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 17th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast, Fire Bolt, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st–5th level (4 5th-level slots). Banishment, Burning Hands, Flame Strike, Hellish Rebuke, Magic Circle, Scorching Ray, Scrying, Stinking Cloud, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
sections.Traits: Dark One's Own Luck (recharges after a short or long rest). After making an ability check or saving throw, the warlock can add 1d10 to the roll before any of its effects occur.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

name: Warlock of the Great Old One

statBlock.name: Warlock of the Great Old One
statBlock.description: This warlock draws power from a distant eldritch being. It might work alongside aberrations and cultists or investigate the harm its patron has caused.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Jump, Levitate, Mage Armor (self only), Speak with Dead.
1/day each. Arcane Gate, True Seeing.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 14th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Eldritch Blast, Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots). Armor of Agathys, Arms of Hadar, Crown of Madness, Clairvoyance, Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dissonant Whispers, Dominate Beast, Telekinesis, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Traits: Whispering Aura. If the warlock is not incapacitated, at the start of each of its turns it chooses creatures within 5 ft. Each chosen creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failure.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Warlord
statBlock.description: This renowned commander can rally devoted followers and might turn a run of victories into an army command or a claim to the throne.

sections.Traits:
Indomitable (3/day). The warlord can reroll a failed saving throw and must use the new result.
Survivor. At the start of its turn, the warlord regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is below half its hit point maximum.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The warlord has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Weapon Attack (1 action). Make one weapon attack.
Command Ally (1 action). Choose an ally the warlord can see within 30 ft. If it can see and hear the warlord, the ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack with advantage.
Frighten Foe (2 actions). Choose a visible enemy within 30 ft. If the enemy can see and hear the warlord, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of the warlord’s next turn.
